# AddChannelEffect <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AddChannelEffect:Int32 channel:Int32, type:Int32, position:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound), [PlayMusic](PlayMusic), [EmitSound](EmitSound) or [MovieChannel](MovieChannel). |
| `type` | In | Int32 | required | `BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS` to `BB_EFFECT_LOFI` (1 to 12) from the shipped include file audio.bb. `0`, which a `BB_` name is when audio.bb is not included, is a runtime error, and so is any other number. |
| `position` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Where in the chain it goes: `-1` (the default) at the end, `0` before the first effect, and so on. Below -1 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Adds an effect to the chain of one channel, such as a low-pass for a sound behind a wall. It takes the same types and parameters as [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect), but works on this sound only and ends with it. See [Audio effects](Audio-Effects). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* The chain runs on the sound after its volume and pitch, before its pan. An echo or reverb on a channel stops with the sound: put the channel on a bus with the effect when the tail should ring out. When the channel ends, its effects still take their commands, which then change nothing, like the commands of a channel that is over. A channel that is over, or no channel (`0`, when there is no sound device), gives such an effect too.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
ch = EmitSound(engine, ship)
wall = AddChannelEffect(ch, BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS)
; Every frame: muffled while the ship is out of sight.
If EntityVisible(camera, ship) Then cutoff = 20000 Else cutoff = 800
AudioEffectParam wall, BB_EFFECTPARAM_FREQUENCY, cutoff, 150
```
@return The effect, for [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam), [AudioEffectBypass](AudioEffectBypass) and [FreeAudioEffect](FreeAudioEffect).
